posts.text: Across the nation, housing shortages are driving up costs for working families. That’s why I signed new bills that cut red tape and modernize building codes, speeding up new construction and ensuring more families can call Michigan home.
posts.summary: Backs bills to cut red tape and modernize building codes for housing

The Gordie Howe bridge is proof that when we work together, we can get hard things done.

I made sure this bridge opened to deliver a better economic future for all. Everyone should be able to make it in Michigan.
posts.summary: Touts bridge project as proof bipartisan cooperation delivers economic benefits

posts.text:
The Gordie Howe International Bridge opens today! This morning, I got behind the wheel of a Michigan-built Ford Mustang to mark the official opening. 
 
I fought to open this bridge to build the economy and connect Michiganders to opportunities on both sides of the Detroit River.
posts.summary: Celebrates bridge opening as economic and opportunity driver

Since my first day in office, protecting Michiganders has been a top priority.

Yesterday, I was proud to reinforce this commitment with a series of bills that support first responders and expand emergency alert systems - because everyone deserves to be safe here in Michigan.
posts.summary: Supports bills to aid first responders and expand emergency alerts

Getting sick shouldn’t mean going broke. That's why we're investing $184 million to combat the damage inflicted by cuts from DC Republicans.

We're protecting Medicaid, food benefits, and job opportunities because everyone deserves to make it in Michigan.
posts.summary: Opposes Republican healthcare cuts, protects Medicaid and benefits

posts.text:
Every Michigander deserves a quality, affordable place to call home.
  
That’s why I'm delivering on my promise to expand housing opportunity. Today, I signed a new bipartisan housing budget that cuts red tape, lowers housing costs, and makes more homes available to families.
posts.summary: Expands housing opportunity through budget cuts and investor restrictions
posts.quote:
Every Michigander deserves a quality, affordable place to call home.
  
That’s why I'm delivering on my promise to expand housing opportunity. Today, I signed a new bipartisan housing budget that cuts red tape, lowers housing costs, and makes more homes available to families.

posts.text:
But that’s not all.
  
I’m also signing a bill to prohibit institutional investors from owning more than 100 single family homes in Michigan -- meaning more working families have a shot at finding their dream home.

posts.text:
Over the last 7.5 years, I’ve been proud to fight for the things that make a real difference for Michiganders.
   
More jobs. Good roads. Reduced costs. Increased opportunity.
   
Today, I'm proud to build on this work by signing my eighth and final balanced, bipartisan budget.
posts.summary: Touts record of job creation, infrastructure, cost reduction over tenure

posts.text:
In my State of the State Address earlier this year, I laid out a comprehensive plan to improve literacy across the state.  
   
Today, I was proud to sign a bipartisan education budget that invests the most funding dedicated to literacy in state history.￼
posts.summary: Signs bipartisan budget with record literacy funding
posts.quote:
In my State of the State Address earlier this year, I laid out a comprehensive plan to improve literacy across the state.  
   
Today, I was proud to sign a bipartisan education budget that invests the most funding dedicated to literacy in state history.￼

posts.text:
Here's how we're using it: 
  
☀️ Improving early starts with free pre-k for all 4-year-olds 
  
📚 Reinforcing proven methods with LETRS training, literacy coaches, and science of reading
🤝 Expanding extra help programs through tutoring and out-of-school programming￼
posts.summary: Promotes pre-K expansion, literacy training, and tutoring programs

Stop 3 of the Summer Reading Road Trip is in full swing, and that means it’s time to sign up for a library card! 
 
Find your local library at mi.countingopinions.com/fdir…, or visit Michigan.gov/LibraryCard to sign up for a card from the Library of Michigan!

Michigan: it’s Shark Week!

Anyone who knows me knows that I love 2 things: Shark Week and a balanced, bipartisan budget. Why not combine them?

Scroll through to see what your favorite shark (and their matching budget win!) says about you.
Every pet deserves compassion, care, and a loving home. That’s why I was proud to sign a package of bills that deliver resources to shelters and protect abused and homeless animals from further harm.

Guess what, Michigan? Stop #3 of our Summer Reading Road Trip is here!

Over the next two weeks, you’ll be stopping in at your local public library to read, explore, and most importantly: sign up for a library card (if you haven't already)!

Here are your challenges ⬇️⬇

#1: Sign up for a library card at your library

#2: Check out and finish a book from the library

#3: Attend an event hosted by your library

#4: Join a club that meets at a Michigan library and attend a meeting

#5: Add four more entries to your summer journal. Consider reflecting on something new you learned while exploring your library.

Don't wait! Submissions for Stop #3 are already open on Michigan.gov/SummerReadingRo….
